opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: New Projects and Commissions max £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections max £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications max £5,000; Long-Term Research max £20,000; Research and Travel max £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating in a non-profit capacity for at least 12 months) for New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications, and Long-Term Research categories. Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators for the Research and Travel category. Not open to individuals wishing to develop their own artistic practice.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, funding exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, and collection development through acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing and display. Applications considered four times per year.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation for travel and subsistence: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, rest of world up to £1,000, plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Visiting Research Fellowships); researchers whose interests lie in Henry Moore specifically (Studios & Gardens fellowships); artists developing their practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships); established scholars for six-week Senior Fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling artists and researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute's research facilities in Leeds or Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses. Applications closed for 2026/27; next round opens in spring 2027.
